name: ui-root
title: UI root
description: Makes a region of any app a Beamline root: theme, brand and direction for everything inside, and a matching layer at page level where its menus, dialogs and tooltips open.
whenToUse: Using Beamline inside an app that has its own styles: wrap only the screens or widgets that use the system, so nothing outside the root is affected.
A region with a different theme, brand or direction from the rest of the page (a dark trading panel in a light app).
notFor: An app built entirely on the system: put class="pui dark" on <html> instead (no wrapper, overlays open in the page).
Right-to-left text alone inside an existing root (direction).

anatomy: root (div.pui with the theme class, data-theme, data-accent, dir, and --pui-brand when set)
portal layer (div.pui appended to <body>, mirroring theme, accent, brand and dir; every overlay inside the root renders into it)
states: server and first client render: managed portal pending
appearance changed: same controls and portal node
inherit=false resets numeric foundation parameters on both root and stable portal
per-host CSS timing overrides are resolved independently of sibling regions
keyboard: None of its own; sets the direction Radix parts use for ←/→ inside rtl.
spec.motion: None. Changing theme switches tokens in one frame.

props.name: theme
props.description: Theme for everything inside, overlays included.

props.name: brand
props.description: Any CSS colour; becomes --pui-brand. Accent, focus ring, series 1 and glows derive from it (Prism keeps its spectrum for charts and takes the brand for its main action, focus ring and glows).

props.name: accent
props.description: A preset brand when no brand colour is given. Unset, the look's own brand applies (Prism: white light in dark, ink-black in light; Pop: tomato; the others: blue).

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction for the region and its overlays.

props.name: look
props.description: The look inside, overlays included: type, icon weight, corners, page colours and paint (DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md "Looks"). Independent of theme.

props.name: motionScale
props.description: Animation speed: multiplies every duration and spring in CSS and JS (1 = foundation default). Reduced and none motion still win.

props.name: radiusScale
props.description: Roundness: scales the style's corner radii (0 = square); a style's pinned corners stay.

props.name: typeScale
props.description: Type size: multiplies every step of the type scale and every type role.

props.name: typeRatio
props.description: Type contrast: how far headings sit from 14px body (<1 flatter, >1 more dramatic).

props.name: spaceScale
props.description: Spacing: scales spacing tokens and Tailwind padding, margin and gap utilities; control heights, icon sizes and row density stay.

props.name: preset
props.description: A built-in look or a custom preset { id, visualContract: 1, base } whose stylesheet the app imports.

props.name: density
props.description: Row density for tables, grids and order books in this scope and its overlays.

props.name: motion
props.description: Motion mode; auto follows the OS.

spec.appearance: Managed appearance changes preserve mounted controls and operational state. Instance design props override scoped defaults; classNames addresses documented slots. Preset references are pure; selected CSS is imported explicitly. Nested scopes merge sparse tokens/defaults; inherit=false resets managed inputs. Managed appearance updates preserve mounted controls and operational state. Motion reads individual CSS duration, easing, spring and stagger tokens at the actual host; no first-document-root lookup. Reduced/none policy wins over speed; semantic reading intervals and data pacing do not scale.

composition: Every overlay (dialog, sheet, popover, menus, select, tooltip, hover card, toast) reads usePortalContainer() from here.

review.notes: New: the isolation root for host apps.

states: server render (no portal layer yet; overlays are closed)

notes: Foundation exceptions (O1 §14.2): the demo passes a literal brand colour (oklch) because that is the customer input UIRoot's brand prop takes; nothing in the component bakes a colour.
